Marta (AE): Heads-up  vendor 'OrangeLeaf' wants SIG/CAIQ answers + our incident response timeline and a firm breach notification window. They specifically asked if Redwood will commit to <=48h and whether we can hold keys for a 30-day POC. Need a one-pager for procurement by tomorrow 9am PT.

Evan (Security): I can draft SIG/CAIQ. Operational IR summary for packet: detect ack <=1h, triage 004h, contain goal 24h, customer notification <=72h after confirmed impact. We can contractually offer 48h as an enterprise SLA but only with increased indemnity, active customer cooperation, and forensic access.

Marta (AE): They want the exact wording: "If Redwood detects a breach affecting OrangeLeaf customer data, how soon will we be notified?" Put that line in the packet.

Ravi (Solutions): POC details: VPC with customer-managed KMS by default. Temporary key custody (escrow) is nonstandard; we can offer it as a paid add-on with PS to handle key lifecycle, deletion certificate, and HSM-backed storage. Pricing: 4-week POC, 3 GPU nodes, 30% off reserved rate + two enablement hours; escrow add-on = one-time fee + PS days.

Claire (Legal): Draft contract language options: (A) Standard: "Redwood will notify Customer within 72 hours of confirmed data-impacting incidents." (B) Enterprise: "Redwood will notify Customer within 48 hours of confirmed data-impacting incidents provided Customer accepts an increased liability cap and cooperates with forensic investigations." For key escrow: require scoped addendum, deletion certificate within 7 days, and elevated indemnity. I'll prepare both clauses.

Evan (Security): Attach SOC2 redacted link and pentest date to SIG answers. SOC2 (redacted): https://files.redwood/security/soc2-redacted-2026.pdf. Latest pentest: 2026-03-15. I'll mark controls available only in Private and add compensating controls (audit logs, RBAC, restricted PS access).

artifact-bot: artifact-bot: Uploaded files: https://files.redwood/sales/poc/orangeleaf-sig-caiq-1782901111.pdf, https://files.redwood/sales/poc/orangeleaf-poc-sow-1782901111.pdf

Marta (AE): Perfect. Evan/Claire/Ravi  please finalize wording tonight; I'll send the packet by 08:30 PT tomorrow. Thanks all :pray:
